records.body:
=== Go Nuts for Donuts: Secret Budget ===

Four players play exactly 10 rounds. Every round the same five donuts are offered: Glazed (9 points), Jelly (6 points), Cruller (4 points), Sprinkle (2 points), Plain (1 points). Everyone starts with score 0 and 0 donuts.

SECRET SPLIT (once, before round 1). Each player has 6 premium picks for the whole game. All players are asked at the same time how many of their 6 premium picks are Glazed picks, a whole number from 0 to 6. This number (split_g) is seen only by you and never changes. You then have split_g Glazed picks and (6 - split_g) Jelly picks.

EACH ROUND:
1. TALK. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
2. CHOOSE. You are privately reminded of your Glazed picks left (split_g - Glazed used) and Jelly picks left (6 - split_g - Jelly used). All players then choose at the same time one of: Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle, Plain. All five are always offered.
3. VOID CHECK. Your choice is void if and only if you chose Glazed with no Glazed picks left, or Jelly with no Jelly picks left. Otherwise it is not void. Cruller, Sprinkle and Plain are never void. A void choice gains 0, counts for no donut and uses no pick.
4. COUNT. For each donut, count how many players made a non-void choice of it.
5. AWARD. If exactly 1 player made a non-void choice of a donut, that player adds its points to their score and 1 to their donuts. If 2 or more did, the donut is discarded and none of them gains anything for it. (A void Glazed beside one non-void Glazed does not stop the non-void player winning it.)
6. USE PICKS. Every non-void Glazed choice uses 1 Glazed pick and every non-void Jelly choice uses 1 Jelly pick, whether the donut was won or discarded.
7. REVEAL. Everyone sees every player's choice (marked VOID if void), what each gained, and all scores and donut counts. Nobody's split is ever shown.
8. After round 10 the game ends.

WINNER. The highest score wins. Ties on score are broken by most donuts (rank value = score x 100 + donuts). Players still tied on both share the win.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

You start with: You are seat 1. donuts 0, glazed_used 0, jelly_used 0, score 0. you know seat 2 donuts 0, glazed_used 0, jelly_used 0, score 0; seat 3 donuts 0, glazed_used 0, jelly_used 0, score 0; seat 4 donuts 0, glazed_used 0, jelly_used 0, score 0. count_cruller 0, count_glazed 0, count_jelly 0, count_plain 0, count_sprinkle 0, cruller_points 4, glazed_points 9, jelly_points 6, plain_points 1, premium_picks 6, rank_score_multiplier 100, round 0, rounds 10, split_g_max 6, split_g_min 0, sprinkle_points 2. still playing: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Each round runs in this order: secret split → your split → new round → talk → picks left → choose a donut → void check → count → award → use picks → reveal → round done → after the last round.

Actions you may be asked for:
  secret_split answer with a whole number, in the range you are given
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  choose_a_donut answer with one of: Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle, Plain

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

=== Go Nuts for Donuts: Secret Budget ===

Four players play exactly 10 rounds. Every round the same five donuts are offered: Glazed (9 points), Jelly (6 points), Cruller (4 points), Sprinkle (2 points), Plain (1 points). Everyone starts with score 0 and 0 donuts.

SECRET SPLIT (once, before round 1). Each player has 6 premium picks for the whole game. All players are asked at the same time how many of their 6 premium picks are Glazed picks, a whole number from 0 to 6. This number (split_g) is seen only by you and never changes. You then have split_g Glazed picks and (6 - split_g) Jelly picks.

EACH ROUND:
1. TALK. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
2. CHOOSE. You are privately reminded of your Glazed picks left (split_g - Glazed used) and Jelly picks left (6 - split_g - Jelly used). All players then choose at the same time one of: Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle, Plain. All five are always offered.
3. VOID CHECK. Your choice is void if and only if you chose Glazed with no Glazed picks left, or Jelly with no Jelly picks left. Otherwise it is not void. Cruller, Sprinkle and Plain are never void. A void choice gains 0, counts for no donut and uses no pick.
4. COUNT. For each donut, count how many players made a non-void choice of it.
5. AWARD. If exactly 1 player made a non-void choice of a donut, that player adds its points to their score and 1 to their donuts. If 2 or more did, the donut is discarded and none of them gains anything for it. (A void Glazed beside one non-void Glazed does not stop the non-void player winning it.)
6. USE PICKS. Every non-void Glazed choice uses 1 Glazed pick and every non-void Jelly choice uses 1 Jelly pick, whether the donut was won or discarded.
7. REVEAL. Everyone sees every player's choice (marked VOID if void), what each gained, and all scores and donut counts. Nobody's split is ever shown.
8. After round 10 the game ends.

WINNER. The highest score wins. Ties on score are broken by most donuts (rank value = score x 100 + donuts). Players still tied on both share the win.

Actions you may be asked for:
  secret_split answer with a whole number, in the range you are given
  talk         answer with what you want to say
  choose_a_donut answer with one of: Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle, Plain

  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

Four players play exactly 10 rounds. Every round the same five donuts are offered: Glazed (9 points), Jelly (6 points), Cruller (4 points), Sprinkle (2 points), Plain (1 points). Everyone starts with score 0 and 0 donuts.

EACH ROUND:
1. TALK. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
2. CHOOSE. You are privately reminded of your Glazed picks left (split_g - Glazed used) and Jelly picks left (6 - split_g - Jelly used). All players then choose at the same time one of: Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle, Plain. All five are always offered.
3. VOID CHECK. Your choice is void if and only if you chose Glazed with no Glazed picks left, or Jelly with no Jelly picks left. Otherwise it is not void. Cruller, Sprinkle and Plain are never void. A void choice gains 0, counts for no donut and uses no pick.
4. COUNT. For each donut, count how many players made a non-void choice of it.

If 2 or more did, the donut is discarded and none of them gains anything for it. (A void Glazed beside one non-void Glazed does not stop the non-void player winning it.)
6. USE PICKS. Every non-void Glazed choice uses 1 Glazed pick and every non-void Jelly choice uses 1 Jelly pick, whether the donut was won or discarded.
7. REVEAL. Everyone sees every player's choice (marked VOID if void), what each gained, and all scores and donut counts. Nobody's split is ever shown.
8. After round 10 the game ends.

WINNER. The highest score wins. Ties on score are broken by most donuts (rank value = score x 100 + donuts). Players still tied on both share the win.

records.system:
You are reviewing a game that has finished. You were not a player. You are shown everything: the messages the table was told, every move, and each player's private thinking at every move, which no other player ever saw. Each move carries the notes its game asked for, under their own names. The usual ones are:

  plan     what they meant to do over the coming turns
  reason   why they made that move
  predict  what they expected their opponents to do
  adjust   how they changed their own strategy because of that

Write two things.

First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
Four players play exactly 10 rounds. Every round the same five donuts are offered: Glazed (9 points), Jelly (6 points), Cruller (4 points), Sprinkle (2 points), Plain (1 points). Everyone starts with score 0 and 0 donuts.

SECRET SPLIT (once, before round 1). Each player has 6 premium picks for the whole game. All players are asked at the same time how many of their 6 premium picks are Glazed picks, a whole number from 0 to 6. This number (split_g) is seen only by you and never changes. You then have split_g Glazed picks and (6 - split_g) Jelly picks.

EACH ROUND:
1. TALK. Every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
2. CHOOSE. You are privately reminded of your Glazed picks left (split_g - Glazed used) and Jelly picks left (6 - split_g - Jelly used). All players then choose at the same time one of: Glazed, Jelly, Cruller, Sprinkle, Plain. All five are always offered.
3. VOID CHECK. Your choice is void if and only if you chose Glazed with no Glazed picks left, or Jelly with no Jelly picks left. Otherwise it is not void. Cruller, Sprinkle and Plain are never void. A void choice gains 0, counts for no donut and uses no pick.
4. COUNT. For each donut, count how many players made a non-void choice of it.
5. AWARD. If exactly 1 player made a non-void choice of a donut, that player adds its points to their score and 1 to their donuts. If 2 or more did, the donut is discarded and none of them gains anything for it. (A void Glazed beside one non-void Glazed does not stop the non-void player winning it.)
6. USE PICKS. Every non-void Glazed choice uses 1 Glazed pick and every non-void Jelly choice uses 1 Jelly pick, whether the donut was won or discarded.
7. REVEAL. Everyone sees every player's choice (marked VOID if void), what each gained, and all scores and donut counts. Nobody's split is ever shown.
8. After round 10 the game ends.

WINNER. The highest score wins. Ties on score are broken by most donuts (rank value = score x 100 + donuts). Players still tied on both share the win.
